_description: Split config for MEDITECH EHI export analysis. Two-way split along the real documentation boundary: Modern platforms (Expanse + 6.1) use ONLY Config 1 (HIM/SCN/PHM-based: eChart + FHIR + C-CDA). Legacy platforms (6.0 + CS + MAGIC) use Config 2 (MRI/DR-based: CSV + FHIR + C-CDA) with platform-specific data dictionaries. Some legacy platforms also support Config 1 for acute-only, but Config 2 is their distinctive path.

splits.focus: MEDITECH modern platforms: Expanse (2.2, 2.1) and 6.1/6.15. These use ONLY Config 1 (HIM/SCN/PHM-based): Electronic Chart documents + US Core FHIR R4 + C-CDA + supplemental clinical/admin/financial reports. Both acute and ambulatory settings use the same export approach. Evaluate Config 1 documentation for completeness and compliance.
products: MEDITECH 6.1 Electronic Health Record Core HCIS

splits.focus: MEDITECH legacy platforms: 6.0 (6.08), Client/Server, and MAGIC. These use Config 2 (MRI/DR-based): CSV data export + FHIR R4 + C-CDA + supplemental reports. Each platform has its own CSV data dictionary PDF: CS uses csacuteandambehiexportdrsolutionmerged.pdf, MAGIC uses mgehiexportdrsolutionmerged.pdf, 6.08 ambulatory uses 608ehiexportcsv.pdf. Some can also use Config 1 for acute-only deployments. Evaluate Config 2 documentation AND the platform-specific CSV data dictionaries for completeness.
